name: Revit Families (make a family from data)
description: Make loadable Revit families from data. revit_make_family builds a box family with pipe, duct or electrical connectors from a spec, saves the .rfa inside the workspace, loads it into the project and checks it with revit_probe_family. It is a write tool: it needs an approved plan and rolls back on failure unless on_error is skip. dry_run builds and checks without saving or loading.
author: AEC Model Bridge

commands.title: Make a Family From a Spec (box body and connectors)

name.description: Family name and file name (without .rfa). Must not contain \ / : * ? " < > | and must be unique in the call.

category.description: mech: Mechanical Equipment (pipe, duct or elec ports, at least one pipe or duct). plumb: Plumbing Fixtures (pipe, elec; at least one pipe). air: Air Terminals (duct, elec; at least one duct). elec_eq: Electrical Equipment, elec_fx: Electrical Fixtures, light: Lighting Fixtures (elec only). A category that does not fit the port kinds is refused.

pos.description: [x, y, z] of the port in metres, relative to the family origin. The body box is centred on x and y with its bottom at z=0.

dir.description: Outward direction of the connector: the face of the small port cube it sits on.

kind.description: Connector type. elec and electrical mean the same.

system.description: pipe: cold, hot, san, vent, hsup, hret. duct: supply, return, exhaust, outdoor. elec: power (default), data.

dia_mm.description: Connector diameter in millimetres. Required for pipe and duct, not allowed for elec.

flow.description: Flow direction at the connector. Pipe and duct only; optional.

label.description: Your own name for the port (printable ASCII, at most 80 characters). Used in messages.

ports.description: Connectors, at most 40. Each one gets a 40 mm cube on its pos and a real connector on the cube face named by dir.

specs.description: 1 to 5 family specs, built in order. The spec format is that of docs/recipes/villa2/m1_specs.json. Use this tool for a connector-bearing equipment, fixture or terminal family; use revit_execute_python for any other family shape.

output_dir.description: Folder for the saved .rfa files, one per spec named <name>.rfa. Must lie inside the allowed workspace directories; it is created when missing.

template_path.description: Optional .rft family template to use for every spec, inside the allowed workspace directories. Without it the Revit family template folder is searched for a template that fits the category (generic model as the fallback). If none is found the call fails with template_not_found; no path is guessed.

replace.description: Overwrite an existing .rfa file and load over a project family of the same name. Default false: either one stops the call before anything changes.

on_error.description: abort (default): the first failure rolls the whole call back and removes the .rfa files it wrote. skip: keep the families that worked and list the failures.

dry_run.description: Default false. true: build and check every family document as normal, then close it unsaved. No .rfa file or folder is written and nothing is loaded into the project; the rows say which file a real run would write. Still needs an approved plan like any write.
